stories.title: Government releases 1,000 crore in PMEGP subsidies
stories.summary: The Ministry of MSME has released 1,000 crore in margin money subsidies under the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme. The funds are intended to support 11,333 new micro enterprises across India. Union Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi announced the disbursement during a special function in New Delhi.

stories.title: India and US trade pact nears completion
stories.summary: India and the US have resolved the bulk of issues regarding a proposed trade deal, including tariff lines. External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that negotiations are approaching the finishing line. The agreement could be sealed soon, potentially coinciding with a meeting between Prime Minister Modi and President Trump.

stories.title: Food inflation hits double digits in southern states
stories.summary: Food inflation exceeded 10 percent in all five southern states during October. According to MoSPI data, Andhra Pradesh recorded the highest inflation at 13.23 percent, followed by Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, and Kerala. Rising prices for onions and garlic are driving the increase in monthly grocery bills.

stories.title: Five sectors drive record October exports
stories.summary: India's merchandise exports rose 45.1 percent year-on-year to a record 49.47 billion dollars in October. Engineering, petroleum, and electronics were among the five sectors accounting for 83 percent of the growth. Cumulative shipments from April to October reached 309.06 billion dollars, a 22 percent increase.

stories.title: Commerce minister eyes 1 trillion dollar export target
stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is on track to reach a 1 trillion dollar export target for the current financial year. The country recorded exports of nearly 90 billion dollars in October. Geopolitical uncertainties remain a factor in the government's long-term trade strategy.

stories.title: Government sets 2 trillion dollar export goal for 2030
stories.summary: The government aims to reach 2 trillion dollars in exports by 2030-31, split evenly between merchandise and services. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has directed officials to focus on MSMEs, agriculture, and global branding. A new monitoring framework will track progress across specific sectors including textiles and pharmaceuticals.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty extend winning streak
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks recorded a third consecutive week of gains, supported by 84,000 crore in foreign institutional investor buying. The rally persisted despite retail inflation breaching the RBI tolerance band and crude oil prices approaching 96 dollars per barrel. The winning streak is the longest since June.

stories.title: Markets drop as Middle East conflict continues
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks fell over 2 percent on Thursday following comments from US President Donald Trump regarding the Middle East conflict. The decline erased gains from the previous session. The Sensex dropped 1,518 points, while the Nifty 50 fell 462 points during early trade.

stories.title: Sensex, Nifty open higher as falling crude, easing geopolitical tension boost market sentiment - DD News
stories.summary: Indian markets continued their green streak at the opening bell on Thursday, aided by falling crude oil prices, improved global risk sentiment, hopes of easing geopolitical tensions, and strong domestic liquidity absorption by Domestic Institutional Investor (DIIs). Domestic benchmarks traded with modest gains during the early session. The SENSEX stood

stories.title: Markets extend losing streak to five sessions
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices ended lower for the fifth consecutive session on Friday. Persistent geopolitical tensions in West Asia and concerns over US trade tariffs have weighed on investor sentiment. The Sensex fell 331 points to close at 76,059, while the Nifty 50 declined 102 points.

stories.title: IT and banking stocks lead market recovery
stories.summary: Indian equity indices rose more than 1 percent on Friday, supported by IT and banking gains. The Nifty 50 closed at 24,206, while the Sensex ended at 77,569. Analysts attributed the recovery to easing crude oil prices and improved foreign investor sentiment following a brief market correction.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty climb on lower energy prices
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks closed higher on Wednesday as lower energy prices boosted sentiment. The Sensex advanced 773 points to 81,879, while the Nifty gained 210 points. Banking, auto, and PSU bank stocks supported the rally, with the Nifty SmallCap 100 index rising 1.59 percent.

stories.title: IT stocks drive market recovery
stories.summary: Indian equity markets rose sharply on Tuesday, with the Sensex gaining 1,109 points to settle at 73,033. The Nifty 50 climbed 358 points to close above 22,700. IT stocks led the rally, climbing over 5 percent following positive sentiment surrounding HCL Technologies earnings.

stories.title: SoftBank sells 1.65% Meesho stake for Rs 1,885 crore
stories.summary: SoftBank Group has sold a 1.65 percent stake in Meesho for Rs 1,885 crore, reducing its holding in the e-commerce company to 5.19 percent. The shares were offloaded by an affiliate through a block deal on the National Stock Exchange. The stake sale found buyers among institutional investors.

stories.title: CCI greenlights Advent International acquisition
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India has approved the acquisition of a shareholding in Yatharth Hospital and Trauma Care Services by Rasmalai Limited. The acquiring entity is controlled by funds managed or advised by private equity firm Advent International. The regulator issued an official release confirming the approval.

stories.title: AURELIUS to acquire Resonac graphite business
stories.summary: Global private equity investor AURELIUS has signed an agreement to acquire the Graphite Business Unit of Japanese industrial giant Resonac Corporation. The unit produces graphite electrodes for electric arc furnaces used in steelmaking. The deal marks the firm's first Japan-related transaction since opening its Tokyo office in June.

stories.title: Warburg Pincus to acquire stake in Pricol Autotech
stories.summary: Private equity firm Warburg Pincus will acquire a 38.51 percent stake in Pricol Autotech for up to Rs 1,663 crore. The transaction follows the planned demerger of the driver information system division from Pricol Limited. The deal includes a mandatory open offer for public shareholders.

stories.title: High Court restricts bank from pension recovery
stories.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court has restrained Jammu and Kashmir Bank from recovering loan dues from a retired police officer's pension account. The court ruled that pension income must be protected to support retirees. The bank had sought to recover funds after a borrower defaulted.

stories.title: ITAT deletes Rs 3.69 crore tax addition
stories.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal deleted a Rs 3.69 crore tax addition imposed on a Firozabad-based woman. The department had treated money passing through her accounts as unexplained income. The tribunal ruled the department failed to establish the money belonged to the taxpayer, setting aside the tax demand.

stories.title: TRAI disconnects over 1.24 lakh mobile connections for spam
stories.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India barred or disconnected more than 1.24 lakh mobile connections between July and September for violating unsolicited commercial communication norms. The regulator also blacklisted 374 entities and blocked 3,725 SMS headers. Spam remains a focus for the regulator in the current fiscal year.
